mapper.select: SELECT user_id as userId, nickname, user_name as name, email, DATE_FORMAT(birth_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as birthDate, gender, DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') as joinedAt, profile_image as profileImage FROM USER WHERE user_id = #{userId}
SELECT ubr.intimacy_id as level, ubr.intimacy_id as remainPoint FROM USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} LIMIT 1
SELECT name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' ELSE '보유' END as state FROM CHAT_BACKGROUND ORDER BY sort_order ASC
SELECT motion_name as name, CASE WHEN unlock_intimacy_level > #{userLevel} THEN '잠금' WHEN motion_group = 'COMMON' THEN '기본' ELSE '보유' END as tag FROM BOT_MOTION ORDER BY motion_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.is_read = FALSE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} AND bl.created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)

SELECT bl.letter_id as id, blt.name as type, '메이티' as sender, bl.title, bl.content as preview, CASE WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = CURDATE() THEN '오늘' WHEN DATE(bl.created_at) = DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) THEN '어제' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(bl.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d') END as date, NOT bl.is_read as unread FROM BOT_LETTER bl JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON bl.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id JOIN BOT_LETTER_TYPE blt ON bl.letter_type_id = blt.letter_type_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bl.created_at DESC

SELECT us.bot_letter_enabled as pushNotice, us.satisfaction_popup_enabled as satisfactionPopup, u.is_marketing_agreed as marketingNotice FROM USER_SETTING us JOIN USER u ON us.user_id = u.user_id WHERE us.user_id = #{userId}

choose.otherwise:
UPDATE USER_SETTING
bot_letter_enabled = #{value}, satisfaction_popup_enabled = #{value},
updated_at = NOW()
WHERE user_id = #{userId}

mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id SET ubr.intimacy_id = ubr.intimacy_id + #{expGain}, ubr.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id SET ubr.intimacy_id = #{exp}, ubr.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT ubr.intimacy_id as level, ubr.intimacy_id as exp FROM USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_BOT_RELATION ubr JOIN EXCLUSIVE e ON ubr.exclusive_id = e.exclusive_id SET ubr.last_interacted_at = NOW(), ubr.updated_at = NOW() WHERE e.user_id = #{userId}
